tha-ap506:1.1: Avaṭaphaliya.] Sahassaraṃsī bhagavā sayambhū aparājito / vivekā vuṭṭhahitvāna gocarāyābhinikkhami. // //
tha-ap506:2.1: Phalahattho ahaṃ disvā upagacchiṃ narāsabhaṃ / pasannacitto sumano avaṭaṃ adadaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap506:3.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ phalaṃ adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phaladānass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap506:7.1: Ittham sudaṃ āyasmā Avaṭaphaliyo thero i. g. a-ti.
